findings: Opening GGML_KIMI_SPLIT_PROFILE produced split timing, but GGML_KIMI_SPLIT_MOE_ASSIGN_PROFILE produced zero assignment lines in the tested paths.
The visible decode CPU split bottleneck at this level is ffn_moe_gate -> ffn_scores; up/down work is not exposed as a simple named CPU split suitable for local scheduler handoff.
Adding temporary default-off scan-all and node-dump probes did not produce reliable node-level dump output despite split-profile summaries; those probes were reverted and are not promoted.

This closes the naive scheduler split-local retained handoff route for now. The next implementation should use the existing DeepSeek4/ggml-cpu retained route and handoff probes, where up/down fallback is actually recorded, instead of relying on scheduler first/last node names.
next_action: Run the existing GGML_DS4_GROUPED_RETAINED_ROUTE_PROFILE_OUT / GGML_DS4_GROUPED_RETAINED_HANDOFF_PROFILE_OUT and deepseek4 native retained probes on calibration prompts, then implement the smallest default-off handoff fix at the ggml-cpu/moe_stream helper level if the profile shows a valid producer/consumer pair.
acceptance_impact: No SOTA change. No held-out prompts used. No accepted performance result.
